title: Ye matam hai zehra ki dua
body:
YE MATAM HAI ZEHRA KI DUA
<<DIVIDER>>
HOGA NA KABHI YE HUM SE JUDA
Aye fatehe karbal ibne Ali
Is deen pa inayath hai teri
Jo tune hayaat isko bakshi
Hai aaj bhi ye bas haq ki sada
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Aon-o-Mohammed run ko chale
Lardte hi rahe bhuke pyase
Aur haq ke liye qurbaan huwe
Lashon pa wo Zainab ka sajda
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Maidaa’n ko chale jab ibne Hasan
Pamaal huwa maqtal mein badan
Aur bewa huwe lamhon ki dulhan
Tha khaimai Shai mein hashr bapa
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham Sshakl-e-Nabi Akber sa jawaa’n
Usko jo lagi seene mein sinaa’n
Seene se tha khoo’n ka darya rawaa’n
Ye bhi hai samaa’n Shai ne dekha
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Parde ka muhafiz aur saqqa
Pani ke liye darya ko chala
Aur kat gaye shane mashk chida
Tha sab ke labon par wawaila
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Hal min ki sada jis dam goonji
Asghar ki ajab thi be chaini
Dikhlaye tadap wo maidaa’n ki
Wo teer ki zad par nanha gala
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab waqte Asr ka qareeb aaya
Karne lage Sarwar wada wafa
Aur kaanpi zamene karbobala
Sajde mein kata Sarwar ka gala
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar tan se juda jab Shai ka huwa
Sholon me ghira har ek qaima
Tha ghash mein wahin bimaar pada
Masnad bhi jali bistar bhi jala
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Din dhal gaya aur jab sham huwe
Aur sham-e-gharebaan jab aye
Karti thi talaya Binte Ali
Maidaa’n mein tha har su sannata
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom Sakina roti hai
Ro ro ke jaa’n wo khoti hai
Be chain har ek pal hoti hai
Kehti hai kahan ho aye baba
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai haq-o-sadaqat ki ye sada
Ye gham na kabhi ruk paye ga
Jannat ka yehi hai ek rasta
Is gham ki nigehbaa’n hai Zehra
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Shai ke azadaron ki sada
Bulwalo sab ko karbobala
Dikhla do Sarwar ka rauza
Rauze pa padhen hum ye nauha
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Ashkon se Sohail ab karke wazu
Is gham mein bahao apna lahu
Pohunche ye jahan mein gham har su
Dengi Zehra hum sab ko dua
<<MINI>>
Ye matam hai Zehra ki dua
